# A Spring Basket

*An old friend among the Brenna of Midbarium visits Calyra each spring. Calyra wants a basket ready, and the roads made safer for the visit.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Fairy Forest](../towns/fairy_forest_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Calyra](../npcs/eldest_calyra.md) |
| Level | 40 |
| After | [The Swarming Shore](../quests/kestrel_high_shore.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 80 Creature of the High Shore or the Oaks ([Evil Eye](../monsters/evil_eye.md), [Curse Eye](../monsters/curse_eye.md), [Cold Eye](../monsters/cold_eye.md), [Sharpened Lupin](../monsters/sharpened_lupin.md), [Gloomfur Lupin](../monsters/gloomfur_lupin.md), [Surgeon Eye](../monsters/surgeon_eye.md))
- Talk to [Halcy](../npcs/halcy_child.md)

## Rewards

- 14,725 EXP
- 880 mesos
- +150 standing with [Calyra](../npcs/eldest_calyra.md)
- +15 standing with Fairy Forest
- +60 standing with [Halcy](../npcs/halcy_child.md)
